summary: Frontend testing of the logo carousel mix/ordering and the CMS logo sub-groups. Passed: Admin home_partners shows 3 sub-groups in order (logo-group-vendor/partner/customer) with headings 'Kelompok 1 · Brand —…', 'Kelompok 2 · Partners —…', 'Kelompok 3 · Customers / Clients'. Card titles show '#N · NAME' in uppercase. Typing lowercase in logo-name-{key} turns uppercase right away and blur saves it ('Nama tersimpan' toast). bulk-name-0 is uppercase (filename prefill 'MY TEST LOGO' and typed text); the bulk upload was not submitted. Changing the category moves the card to the matching group and back. Dragging across groups is ignored. Home has 3 rows of 3, mixed in order Brand→Partners→Customers, with no category labels. The row1 first logo matches CMS vendor #1. Tiles are 208x104 (2:1) and the img is 192x88 (8px inset). Every .logo-track uses animation logo-marquee at 52.2s, so every row moves at exactly 40px/s on desktop. Row2 is reverse. Mobile has no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390). CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: dragging to reorder wiped the logo names (alt=null) of every card in the dragged group.

critical.issue: update_asset_meta always wrote alt=payload.alt, so the alt became None whenever it was not sent. Admin persistOrder (drag reorder) sends only {sort_order}, so reordering erased the names of all logos in that group (and subsidiary cards too). FIXED by testing agent: alt is now only updated when not None. Verified the names survive drag + reload.

ui_bugs.issue: When two logos in the same group share sort_order (current data: EVOSMART ECOSYSTEM and EVOWASTE TECHNOLOGY both 100), the CMS breaks the tie by key (EVOWASTE #3, EVOSMART #4). Home has no tie-breaker and the API orders only by sort_order (row order not deterministic), so Home showed EVOSMART before EVOWASTE. This breaks the requirement that CMS numbers match Home order. Fix: add the same tie-breaker on Home (a.key.localeCompare) or use the CMS index, and/or renumber sort_order 1..n per group after uploads/category changes.

issues: TILE_W is fixed at 232 (md size), but mobile tiles are 176+16=192px, so mobile speed is ~33px/s instead of 40. It is the same on every row, so this is minor.
onInput sets e.target.value to uppercase, which moves the caret to the end when editing in the middle of the text. Consider CSS text-transform plus uppercase on save, or restore selectionStart/End.

action_items: Review/keep the backend fix in update_asset_meta (alt only updated when provided)
Make the Home logo order use the same tie-breaker as the CMS (sort_order then key), or renumber sort_order per group so ties cannot happen
Optional: compute the marquee duration from the measured tile width so mobile is also 40px/s; keep the caret position in the uppercase inputs
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 988 lines; split ImagesPanel/AssetCard into their own modules
After a category change the card keeps its old sort_order, so it can land in the middle of the new group or tie with another logo; renumber the target group to put it at the end
